title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Looking for a customer service role where you can make a real difference and turn your experience into a permanent opportunity?
We're looking for a Customer Service Advisor to join a busy team based in Blackburn. This is a full-time temporary role with an immediate start and the opportunity to go permanent, paying 13.45 per hour.
With a variety of shifts available, this is a great opportunity for someone with previous call handling or customer service experience who enjoys helping people, resolving queries and making sure customers receive the support they need.
What will you be doing Customer Service Advisor?
- Answering incoming calls and responding to customer enquiries.
- Managing customer queries and helping to resolve issues efficiently.
- Providing clear information, guidance and reassurance to customers.
- Listening carefully to understand each customer's needs and concerns.
- Delivering a professional and helpful customer service experience.
- Recording relevant information accurately and keeping customer records up to date.
- Escalating incidents or more complex queries to the appropriate team when needed.

What's in it for you?
- 13.45 per hour
- Full-time hours averaging 37.5 hours per week on a planned rota.
- Opportunity to go permanent and a chance to secure a longer-term position.
- Immediate start
- Variety of shifts a range of working patterns to suit the needs of the service.

Why would you join this company?
You'll be joining a team providing an important customer-facing service, where clear communication, reassurance and effective problem-solving make a real difference. With the potential to move from temporary to permanent employment, it's also an opportunity to demonstrate your skills and build towards a longer-term position.

What's essential:
- Previous call handling or customer service experience.
- Good verbal communication skills and a professional telephone manner.
- The ability to listen to customer queries and respond clearly and appropriately.
- Good organisational skills and attention to detail.
- The ability to record information accurately and recognise when an issue needs to be escalated.

What's helpful but not essential:
- Experience handling a high volume of calls.
- Experience dealing with customer complaints, sensitive enquiries or incidents.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Are you a great listener who can stay calm under pressure and help people get the support they need?
We're looking for a Customer Service Advisor or a Call Handler to join a busy out-of-hours helpdesk team in Blackburn. With the busy season approaching, the team is expanding to support an increase in calls from tenants reporting maintenance and repairs requests.
Paying 13.45 per hour, this is a temporary position for 12 weeks working in the evenings during the week and weekends, with the opportunity to go permanent. You'll receive training on the company's established processes and systems, so you'll understand how to assess requests, record information accurately and ensure each issue reaches the right team.
If you have at least 1 year of call centre or customer service experience and enjoy helping people find solutions, this could be a great opportunity for you!
What will you be doing as a Customer Service Advisor / Call Handler?
- Answering a high volume of calls from tenants reporting maintenance and repairs requests
- Listening carefully to understand the problem and asking the right questions to establish the root cause
- Following a structured questionnaire to gather all the necessary information about each issue
- Assessing and triaging requests as emergency, urgent or non-emergency
- Recording information accurately using ticketing systems, drop-down menus and set processes
- Passing completed requests to the appropriate team, who will arrange the necessary repairs or fixes
- Providing reassurance and clear information to tenants, including those who may be vulnerable or distressed
- Recognising when an issue needs further attention and escalating it in line with the relevant procedures

What's in it for you?
- 13.45 per hour
- Opportunity to secure a longer-term position after the initial 12 weeks.
- Established training programme
- 2 paid 10-minute breaks during your shift.
- Unpaid 30-minute lunch break.
- Immediate start
- Valuable experience - develop your call handling, problem-solving and customer service skills in a fast-paced environment

Why would you join this company?
You'll be joining an established team providing an important out-of-hours service, helping tenants report property issues and ensuring their concerns are recorded, prioritised and passed to the right people for action.
Accuracy is key, as the information you gather helps the repairs team understand the problem and arrange the appropriate fix. You'll be supported by an established training process, giving you the knowledge and guidance needed to learn the systems and carry out the role effectively.
This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys helping people, working as part of a team and making a practical difference to the customer experience.
What we're looking for
What's essential:
- At least 1 year's call centre customer service experience.
- Strong listening skills and the ability to ask relevant questions to understand a customer's issue.
- An empathetic approach and good emotional intelligence, particularly when speaking to vulnerable or distressed customers.
- Clear communication skills and a professional telephone manner.
- Excellent attention to detail, ensuring information is recorded accurately and all required questions are answered.
- The ability to follow set procedures and categorise requests correctly.
- The ability to manage a high volume of calls, moving efficiently from one conversation to the next while maintaining good customer service.

What's helpful but not essential:
- Experience in property maintenance, housing, repairs or facilities management.
- Experience using ticketing systems, CRM databases or structured call-handling questionnaires.
- Experience assessing and prioritising customer requests or incidents.

The Essentials
Salary: 13.45 per hour
Hours: Weekday evenings, 5:00 pm-10:00 pm, and weekend shifts, 8:00 am-5:00 pm. Shifts will depend on the rota and service requirements.
Breaks: Two paid 10-minute breaks and one unpaid 30-minute lunch break per shift.
Location: Blackburn
Job type: Temporary for 12 weeks, with the opportunity to go permanent.
Start date: Immediate

To Apply
If you're an experienced call centre professional looking for an immediate start, structured training and the opportunity to secure a permanent position, we'd LOVE to hear from you!

Your new company
You will be joining a well-established manufacturing business based in Blackburn that has built a strong reputation within its sector. title: Complaints Handler

description:
Looking for a great career move in customer services, helping customers resolve their concerns while making sure they receive the highest standard of service?

Based in modern offices in the centre of Blackburn, this is an opportunity to join a successful and expanding business as a Complaints Handler. You'll deal with customer complaints, queries and escalated issues, making sure each one is handled professionally, fairly and with the right level of care.

With a salary of up to 35,000 and an excellent benefits package, this role offers the chance to use your customer service and problem-solving skills in a professional, regulated environment, while developing your knowledge and building a genuine long-term career.

What will you be doing as a Complaints Handler?
- Handling customer complaints and escalated queries, making sure each matter is dealt with professionally and sensitively
- Speaking with customers by telephone and email to understand their concerns and provide solutions
- Managing a varied caseload, ensuring complaints are progressed and deadlines are met
- Investigating complaints, reviewing information and case records to establish what has happened and what action is needed
- Updating of customer records including interactions, actions taken and outcomes
- Working within company procedures and the standards expected within a regulated environment
- Identifying recurring issues and trends in complaints and customer feedback
- Working closely with colleagues across other teams to help maintain high standards of customer service

What's in it for you?
- A salary of 27,000 to 35,000, depending on experience
- 23 days' holiday plus bank holidays, increasing over time to 30 days
- An extra day off for your birthday
- The option to buy additional holidays
- Private healthcare after one year's service
- Pension scheme
- Life insurance worth three times your annual salary
- Bonus scheme based on company performance
- Long-service awards and milestone gifts
- Perkbox rewards scheme
- Company events
- Free on-site parking
- Wellbeing programme
- Rewards of up to 200 for suggestions that help improve the business
- Excellent opportunities for career development and professional qualifications

Why would you join this company?

You'll be joining a successful and expanding business where customer care, quality and compliance are important. As a Complaints Handler, you'll have the opportunity to make a real difference to customers, helping resolve their concerns while ensuring they receive a professional and positive experience.
It's a role where you'll be trusted to take ownership of your caseload and use your judgement, working closely with colleagues across the wider business. As the company continues to grow, there are also genuine opportunities to develop your skills and progress your career.
What we're looking for:
- What's essential:
- Previous experience handling customer complaints, escalations or complex customer queries
- Experience working in a customer service, claims or contact centre environment
- Confident communicating with customers by telephone and email
- A professional and empathetic approach when dealing with difficult or sensitive situations
- Strong verbal and written communication skills
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage your own workload and caseload
- What's helpful but not essential:
- Experience within a legal, financial services or claims environment

title: Private Client Legal Assistant / Secretary - Clitheroe
description:
Private Client Legal Assistant / Secretary - Clitheroe Location: Clitheroe, Lancashire
Salary: £28,000 DOE
Working Pattern: Full-Time, Permanent

An excellent opportunity has arisen for an experienced Private Client Legal Assistant, Legal Secretary or Paralegal to join a well-established law firm in Clitheroe. This is an ideal opportunity for a career legal support professional who enjoys being at the heart of a busy department, providing essential support to a senior fee-earning Director.

This is a key appointment within the firm, offering the opportunity to work closely with an experienced legal professional and play a vital role in the smooth running of the Private Client department. The position would suit someone who takes pride in their work, enjoys building strong client relationships and wants to establish themselves in a long-term legal support career.

The Role You will provide comprehensive legal, administrative and secretarial support to a fee-earning Director, helping to ensure that client matters progress efficiently and that the department operates effectively.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Preparing correspondence, legal documents and client care documentation.
- Opening, maintaining and organising client files.
- Managing diaries, arranging appointments and coordinating client meetings.
- Handling telephone calls, emails and routine client enquiries professionally.
- Assisting with the preparation of legal documents relating to Wills, Probate, Estate Administration and Lasting Powers of Attorney.
- Supporting file management, key date monitoring and the progression of client matters.
- Liaising with clients, colleagues and external contacts to obtain information and documentation.
- Undertaking appropriate paralegal and legal administrative tasks under the supervision of the Director.
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring confidentiality at all times.

This is a varied position where you will become a trusted member of the team, providing the reliable, proactive support that allows a senior fee earner to focus on delivering excellent legal advice and client service.

Requirements
- Previous experience in a legal secretarial, legal assistant or paralegal role.
- Experience within Private Client Law would be advantageous.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Word and other standard office applications.
- A professional, approachable manner and a strong commitment to client care.
- High levels of accuracy, discretion and attention to detail.
- The ability to work independently, use initiative and support colleagues within a busy legal environment.

This role would particularly suit a career legal assistant or paralegal who enjoys the support side of legal practice and is looking for a stable, long-term position rather than a role focused on building and managing their own fee-earning caseload.

Benefits
- Salary of up to £28,000, depending on experience.
- Permanent position within an established legal practice.
- Direct support to a senior fee-earning Director.
- A genuinely important role within the department.
- A varied workload combining legal administration, secretarial support and paralegal responsibilities.
- Opportunities to develop your knowledge and skills within Private Client Law.
- Additional benefits package.

Apply If you are an experienced Private Client Legal Secretary, Legal Assistant or Paralegal looking for your next opportunity in Clitheroe, this is an excellent chance to join a supportive team where your contribution will be genuinely valued.

For a confidential discussion, please contact Patrick McMahon at QED Legal.

description: We are looking for 2 motivated and dynamic medical receptionists, preferably with previous experience to cover 45 hours in total (1 full time, 1 part time or job share considered) to join the team at St James Medical Centre. We are based in leafy Rawtenstall, close to good motorway links. Previous General Practice experience is preferred but training will be given. As part of the admin team the successful candidate will be responsible for greeting patients and arriving them on the clinical system, dealing with queries and appointment requests both in person and by telephone and text message . The practice aims to have staff that are multi skilled and staff will broaden skills, learning to perform other admin functions. The practice is often very busy and therefore resilience and flexibility are required along with excellent communication skills. Answering telephone calls, texts and online request for queries and appointments. Signposting patients to the most appropriate staff or service. Liaising with clinical staff, updating systems, dealing with incoming and outgoing correspondence, processing repeat prescriptions. Supporting colleagues to deal with the daily workload and providing cover as needed where possible. Safeguarding Children and Adults The organisation has a zero tolerance approach to the abuse of children, young people and vulnerable adults. All employees are required to promote and safeguard the welfare of children and young people and comply with the Local Safeguarding Children Board Procedures and the Children Act (1989, 2004). In accordance with the CCG and Local Safeguarding Adult Board policy all staff must ensure the health and wellbeing of vulnerable adults is appropriately safeguarded. All staff are required to attend training appropriate to their role in safeguarding children and adults, which includes understanding and recognising the signs of abuse and knowing how to raise concerns when those signs of abuse are noticed in a person .

Duties can include, but are not limited to, greeting and directing patients, the effective use of the appointment system, booking appointments, the processing of information (electronic and hard copy) in a timely manner and in accordance with current policies, assisting patients as required and supporting the administration team with patient registration. The post-holder will act as the central point of contact for patients, be responsible for the distribution of information, messages and enquiries for the clinical team, liaise with multi-disciplinary team members and external agencies such as secondary care and community service providers. The Receptionist will support staff with the distribution of information, messages and enquiries for the clinical team, liaising with multidisciplinary team members and external agencies such as secondary care and community service providers.
